title: Employ staff under the Dry Cleaning and Laundry Industry Award 2020
what: Pay and employ staff at no less than the terms of the Dry Cleaning and Laundry Industry Award 2020.

laws.title: Dry Cleaning and Laundry Industry Award 2020

sources.title: Dry Cleaning and Laundry Industry Award 2020
sources.quote: 4.1 This industry award covers employers throughout Australia in the dry cleaning and laundry industry and their employees in the classifications listed in Schedule A —Dry Cleaning Classification and Schedule B —Laundry Classifications to the exclusion of any other modern award.

reach.note: National system employers that are companies, in every state.

sources.title: Dry Cleaning and Laundry Industry Award 2020
sources.quote: 4.2 Dry cleaning and laundry industry means the industry of: (a) dry cleaning, dyeing and/or repairing and/or invisible mending of garments or articles in dry cleaning establishments or their auxiliary receiving depots; and (b) washing, sorting and/or packing of laundry in laundries and laundrettes including the repair of items and preparation of garments for rental; and (c) performing any operation incidental to the activities in clauses 4.2(a) or 4.2(b) of this definition in dry cleaning, laundry or combined dry cleaning/laundry establishments [4.3 varied by PR743453 ppc 11Jul22]

sources.title: Which system of employment laws applies
sources.publisher: Government of Western Australia (Private Sector Labour Relations)
sources.quote: The state system covers: Private sector businesses and their employees that operate as: Sole traders. Partnerships, where none of the partners in the business is a constitutional corporation (trading or financial corporation).

assessment.summary: The Dry Cleaning and Laundry Industry Award sets the industry's classifications, minimum pay, allowances and penalty rates on top of the National Employment Standards.

marks.reason: Classifications, allowances, penalty rates and their record-keeping add to the cost and complexity of employing in the industry.

assessment.confidence_note: Economic reasoning and desk research only; no evaluation of this requirement found. Drafted 12 Nov 2026 from the award's coverage clause, not yet checked.
